newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:

Spokesman Gerry Kiely said the Commission was very satisfied with the results of the Farm Council that took place from Monday to Wednesday in Luxembourg. Kiely briefed on the Council conclusions on beef production (see separate article).
In answer to a question, Kiely said Commissioner Fischler had agreed on a discussion report, already in preparation, to analyse reforms of the olive oil sector.

Spokesman Patrick Child said Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy had launched the idea of a round table on practical aspects to ease transition to the Euro with representatives from all concerned sectors.

In answer to a question Child said that Yves Franchet, director general of the European Union's statistics office Eurostat, had accepted France's decision to use a transfer of funds from France Telecom to reduce its 1997 budget deficit. Child also said that this could create a precedent for other member states if in the same situation.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/969: The Commission authorises the acquisition by the Sidmar group of Flachform Stahl AG & Co KG.
- IP/96/973: Commission to help fund poorest countries' attendance at WTO Ministerial.
- IP/96/974: The future of the European aerospace industry - symposium to be held on 5th November at the European Parliament, Brussels.
- Speech/96/267: Intervention by Commissioner Edith Cresson at the first SME technology days.
- Eurostat news release No 72/96: EU annual inflation remains at record low.
- Eurostat, Economy and finance No 1996-10: ECU-EMS information and central bank interest rates.
- Eurostat, Distributive trade, services and transport: Tourism in the Mediterranean (key figures 1994-1995)
- Taxes and duties at October 1996 - Ecus and National currencies.
